shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上画着闪电图标，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with a lightning bolt drawing, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电气区域分类。
overlay: 电压等级与爆炸危险区域

shots.scene: 三个大小不同的闪电图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three lightning bolt icons in a row, large, medium and small. No people.

shots.scene: 工厂里，阿杰看着几扇挂着不同标志的配电室门
shots.prompt_en: In an industrial plant, the young male student looks at several electrical room doors with different warning signs.
shots.narration: 阿杰在厂区看到好几种电气区域。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark bubble above him.

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the whiteboard and raises one finger.

shots.section_title: 电气区域分三类：高压、中压、低压
shots.scene: 白板上三个空白方框，分别配大中小闪电
shots.prompt_en: Three blank boxes on the whiteboard, each with a large, medium or small lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电气区域分类，分成三部分。
overlay: 电气区域分三类：高压、中压、低压

shots.section_title: 电气区域分三类：高压、中压、低压
shots.scene: 大闪电方框发亮
shots.prompt_en: The box with the large lightning bolt lights up. No people.

shots.section_title: 电气区域分三类：高压、中压、低压
shots.scene: 中闪电方框发亮
shots.prompt_en: The box with the medium lightning bolt lights up. No people.

shots.section_title: 电气区域分三类：高压、中压、低压
shots.scene: 小闪电方框发亮
shots.prompt_en: The box with the small lightning bolt lights up. No people.

shots.scene: 大闪电方框旁贴上一张空白分类卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank classification card is attached next to the box with the large lightning bolt. No people.

shots.scene: 高压输电铁塔图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a high voltage transmission tower with power lines. No people.

shots.scene: 电压表指针越过一条刻度线
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon whose needle moves past a marked line into the top zone. No people.

shots.scene: 第一项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A green check mark appears next to the first box. No people.

shots.scene: 中闪电方框旁贴上空白分类卡
shots.prompt_en: A blank classification card is attached next to the box with the medium lightning bolt. No people.

shots.scene: 电压表指针停在两条刻度线之间
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon whose needle rests between two marked lines in the middle zone. No people.

shots.scene: 第二项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A green check mark appears next to the second box. No people.

shots.scene: 小闪电方框旁贴上空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank card is attached next to the box with the small lightning bolt. No people.

shots.scene: 电压表指针停在低位
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon whose needle rests in the low zone below a marked line. No people.

shots.scene: 第三项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A green check mark appears next to the third box. No people.

shots.scene: 三个方框全部打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three boxes on the whiteboard now have green check marks. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣指着白板上三个打勾的方框
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the three checked boxes on the whiteboard.

shots.scene: 大闪电方框和分类卡
shots.prompt_en: The box with the large lightning bolt and its blank classification card. No people.

shots.scene: 中闪电方框和分类卡
shots.prompt_en: The box with the medium lightning bolt and its blank classification card. No people.

shots.scene: 小闪电方框和卡片
shots.prompt_en: The box with the small lightning bolt and its blank card. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of the whiteboard.
